Sets one entry of the gamma tables: color value `src` of a channel is shown as the output value, which can be a fractional number from 0 to 255. Call [UpdateGamma](UpdateGamma) after changing the entries.
@param src_red     The input value for the red table, 0 to 255.
@param src_green   The input value for the green table, 0 to 255.
@param src_blue    The input value for the blue table, 0 to 255.
@param dest_red    The output value for red.
@param dest_green  The output value for green.
@param dest_blue   The output value for blue.
@gap The tables are only stored for [GammaRed](GammaRed) and the others. A window cannot change the gamma of the display, so nothing looks different. The original only worked in full screen as well.
